## tinylm v0.1.0

A small Qwen2-architecture language model trained from scratch, end to end: data cleaning and
MinHash dedup, a byte-level BPE trainer, a hand-written decoder, AdamW and training loop, zero-shot
evaluation, and GGUF export that tinyinfer runs unmodified.

### Highlights
- tl-25m (25.7M params): perplexity 4.64 on the full TinyStoriesV2 validation split after 36.9M
  training tokens (84 min on an RTX 2060, fp16)
- Story cloze 62.4 % / 78.4 % (acc / acc_norm, chance 25 %); grammar minimal pairs 99.5 %
- PyTorch vs tinyinfer C engine logits agree to 7.6e-6 on the trained model
- Speculative decoding in tinyinfer with the 3.15M draft: measured decode speed-ups on a Ryzen 5 3600
  are in the README (greedy output identical to the target alone)

### Downloads
- `tinylm-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl` and `tinylm-0.1.0.tar.gz`, built and tested by CI.
- Model weights are not attached; `scripts/reproduce.sh` retrains them (about 1.5 h on an RTX 2060).

### Not yet verified
- Training on a CPU-only machine (the CPU here was saturated by other jobs during this run)
- tl-125m / tl-300m on FineWeb-Edu, and the FineWeb-Edu parquet download path
